title: Merge
text: After escaping from the partially destroyed inn, I started to think things over. Since they’re attacking me, there’s a possibility my Father and the others are taking some kind of action as well. I didn’t think I’d let my guard down, but it looks like I’d better hurry and give chase. I’ll ask the Demi-Human who was working as the inn’s bodyguard to pass on a message.
“I’m going to chase after my Father… the Shield Hero. If we happen to miss each other, could you please tell my Father and the others that we’ll meet up in the next town?”
“Y-yes!”

And so, I set off after my Father, left the town, and began following the trail of Filolial-sama and her party. However… along the way, their trail became unclear, and I lost sight of them once they turned onto a mountain path.

There’s no need to waste time fighting monsters just yet. My father and his group have likely already secured materials from the monsters in this area. I tracked Filolial-sama and her party by scent until sunset, but it didn’t look like I’d be able to catch up to them. Reluctantly, I returned to town via a portal.

By then, the commotion seemed to have calmed down somewhat. However, I can’t help but feel that the Demi-Humans seem to be radiating a slight air of hostility… When I went to the partially destroyed inn, the bodyguard was cleaning up alongside the innkeeper.
“How’s the situation?”
“Ah! Spear Hero! The Shield Hero and his party stopped by quite a while ago!”
“Hmm… When was that, exactly?”
“After you, Spear Hero, set out… around sunset, I’d say?”
“Is that so?”
It seems this has turned into a massive misunderstanding. I must give chase immediately.

“When the Shield Hero’s party returned here, they were attacked by what appeared to be followers of the Three Heroes Church, but the monsters traveling with them immediately defeated them… and after hearing what we had to say, the Shield Hero and his party set off again.”
“I see.”
It seems my Father and the others have set off safely. That leaves me with no choice but to travel through the night to the next town.
“Excuse me, Spear Hero?”
“What is it?”
“If you were going to chase after the Shield Hero and his party, wouldn’t it have been better to wait for them at the designated town?”
Well… I’d completely forgotten about that. But I, Motoyasu, simply cannot just sit around and wait. At first glance, this might seem like a wasted trip, but it’s better than just waiting!
“Right now, we’re in the process of deploying stand-ins for the Shield Hero to throw off the Three Heroes Church’s assassins. I think the number of assassins will decrease soon. Please rest assured.”
“Understood.”
I see—it seems Siltvelt is deploying lookalikes of my Father along the way. This might make the journey a little easier. And so, I… ended up heading to the next town, traveling all night long.

After racing down the highway at full speed for several hours, the lights of a town finally came into view. Along the way, as I approached the mountains, I sensed the temperature drop slightly. I’m approaching the town gate. It seems this town is a hot spring resort—I can see steam rising from the baths.
“Stop! Who are you?”
“I am The Love Hunter!”
“Huh!? What are you talking about?!”
The town gatekeeper pointed his weapon at me, clearly on guard. How foolish—making him regret it immediately would be one option. After all, I’m on a mission to rush to Father’s side.
“Please wait!”
Someone poked their head out from between the gatekeepers and called out. Judging by their animal-like ears and tail, they must be a Demi-Human.
“This person is an acquaintance of ours. Please allow him to enter.”
“H-huh…”
“Well, if that’s the case, I suppose it’s fine—but he’s a very suspicious-looking fellow.”
“It’s true his words and actions are suspicious… but I’ve heard he’s quite skilled.”
Who could this be? It’s definitely not the same person as the envoy from Siltvelt.
“Come, come—the Shield Hero is waiting for you.”
“Do you happen to know my Father?”
“Yes, I was instructed to bring someone who refers to the Shield Hero as ‘Father.’”

And so, I was able to pass through the gate of the hot spring town. The Demi-Human then guided me straight to the inn where my Father was staying. Perhaps sensing my presence, Yuki-chan and Kou came running out as soon as the inn door opened.
“Motoyasu-sama—”
“Kitamura!”
“Yuki-chan and Kou! I’ve finally gotten to see you!”
“When we returned from the hunt and found the inn in that state, I was really worried!”
“Welcome back, Kitamura. Any souvenirs?”
“I don’t have any souvenirs, but the clothes are already finished.”
I showed them the clothes I’d made for the two of them. Just then, my Father, the others, and Sakura-chan came up from behind.
“Motoyasu-kun! We were worried about you. We went out with everyone, and when we came back, the inn was in such a state.”
“I’m not hurt. More importantly, is Father all right?”
“Yeah. Sakura-chan and the others fought off the people who attacked us.”
“These kids are incredibly strong. It might not even be my turn to step in anymore.”

Éclair said softly. Heh heh heh, just as I thought. The Filolial are the supreme and ultimate race—the strongest of all. There’s no way mere humans could be their match. Still, Éclair has quite the keen insight to have realized that.
“Lord Iwatani was very worried. He hasn’t had a proper rest since we arrived at the inn. Now then, Lord Kitamura, I’d like you to get some rest right away as well.”
“Understood.”
“Fortunately, it seems this is a hot spring resort—isn’t it the perfect place to soothe the fatigue of travel?”
Éclair says this with a somewhat restless air. Hmm…
“Kitamura, get dressed!”
“I’ll let you put it on after you’ve taken a proper bath.”
“Okay! Alright, everyone, let’s go take a bath!”
“That’s right. We’re tired from today, so let’s wash off the sweat and get some rest.”

And so, we all got together and decided to take a dip in the hot springs. The bath we’re using this time seems to be a rock bath. It’s a bit more rustic than the Japanese-style hot springs on Cal Mira Island.

I thought it might be more of a Roman-style bath, but this area is known for its thriving trade. Plus, since the boundaries of dominion shift due to war, civilization hasn’t really taken root here. Even so, there are separate baths for men and women. Well, well…
“Kou is nice, isn’t it? I get to bathe with Motoyasu-sama.”
“Hehehe, Kitamura! Let’s wash each other’s backs later, okay?”
Yuki-chan and the others are chatting cheerfully. However, just as my Father instructed in the past, girls really should use the women’s bath.
“Éclair, I’m counting on you to watch over Yuki-chan and the others.”
“Ugh… just call me whatever you want at this point…”
“Motoyasu-kun… you’re not going to peek, are you?”
“Hahaha, of course I am. Yuki-chan and the others are looking forward to it, you know.”
“What are you saying so brazenly, Lord Kitamura!”

Well, I doubt I’ll find Filo-tan here, but when it comes to hot springs, peeping is a man’s duty. Women become more attractive when they’re looked at. Yuki-chan and the others also become more attractive as women by experiencing the bashfulness of hiding their naked bodies from men who are peeping at them. As a parent, that’s a belief I must teach them. I, Motoyasu, have absolutely nothing to feel guilty about.
“I’ve always thought this, but I just can’t understand Motoyasu-kun’s philosophy at all…”
“Are you sure you’ll be okay without Naofumi, Sakura? Want to join us?”
“Huh? Hmm. Motoyasu-kun and Kou are here, so it’ll be fine. You should go take a bath in the women’s section too, Sakura-chan.”
“Got it—then I’ll come see Naofumi later, okay?”
“Were you actually listening? Ms. Éclair, I’m counting on you to look after everyone.”
“Mm-hmm, understood. Lord Iwatani, I also ask that you keep Lord Kitamura in check.”
“Yeah, got it. I’ll do my best within reason.”
As my father-in-law and Éclair were having this conversation, Éclair let out a deep sigh.
“Just when did I end up having to look after these kids…”
“Motoyasu-kun is very dependable, but he goes off the rails sometimes, so it’s hard to reason with him.”
“Hahahaha! You must be joking. This Motoyasu is sincerely doing his best for you, Father!”
“‘Sigh…’”
For some reason, my Father and the others let out deep sighs before heading off to their respective baths.
